dialogues.jp: 「ただいま」
dialogues.en: "Hey, Nemu."
dialogues.text: "Hey, Nemu."

dialogues.jp:
テレビに向いていた音夢が、ぱっと笑顔を振り
向けてくる。
dialogues.en: Sitting on the sofa, I begin to ask her.
dialogues.text: Sitting on the sofa, I begin to ask her.

dialogues.jp: 「なあ、音夢」
dialogues.en: "Do you remember what the day after tomorrow is?"
dialogues.text: "Do you remember what the day after tomorrow is?"

dialogues.jp: ソファーに腰掛けながら、俺は｛たず／訊｝ねた。
dialogues.en: "The day after tomorrow? The graduation is tomorrow, and..."
dialogues.text: "The day after tomorrow? The graduation is tomorrow, and..."

dialogues.jp: 「明後日、何の日か覚えてるか？」
dialogues.en:
Nemu looks up at the ceiling and mumbles something. Then her
eyes start to jiggle.
dialogues.text:
Nemu looks up at the ceiling and mumbles something. Then her
eyes start to jiggle.

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「明後日？　卒業式は明日よね。明後日……？」
dialogues.en: "And... Ah!"
dialogues.text: "And... Ah!"

dialogues.jp:
視線を天井に向け、むにゃむにゃと呟く。と、
その瞳がおどおどと揺れ始めた。
dialogues.en: "I knew it. She has a better memory than me."
dialogues.text: "I knew it. She has a better memory than me."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「あ、と、その……」

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
「……やっぱ、俺とは違うな。すぐに思い出し
　たか」
dialogues.en: "Here you go. Miharu asked me to give it to you."
dialogues.text: "Here you go. Miharu asked me to give it to you."

dialogues.jp: ポケットから丁寧に折り畳んだ紙片を取り出す。
dialogues.en:
I take the well-folded card out of my pocket and give it to
her.
dialogues.text:
I take the well-folded card out of my pocket and give it to
her.

dialogues.jp:
手を突き出すと、それが熱でも持っているかの
ように、音夢はそっとつまみ上げた。
dialogues.en: Nemu picks it up gently and carefully.
dialogues.text: Nemu picks it up gently and carefully.

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「誕生日……美春の……」
dialogues.en: "Miharu's birthday..."
dialogues.text: "Miharu's birthday..."

dialogues.jp:
呟き。それは、記憶からこぼれたのか、それと
も文字を目で追ったのか……。
dialogues.en:
Nemu mumbles, but I'm not sure if it's from memory or from
reading the message on the card.
dialogues.text:
Nemu mumbles, but I'm not sure if it's from memory or from
reading the message on the card.

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「兄さん、でも、私……」
dialogues.en: "Niisan, I..."
dialogues.text: "Niisan, I..."

dialogues.jp: 叱られた子犬のような目で見上げてくる。
dialogues.en: Nemu looks up at me like a puppy being scolded by its owner.
dialogues.text: Nemu looks up at me like a puppy being scolded by its owner.

dialogues.jp: 「まだ、吹っ切れないのか？」
dialogues.en: "Is it still bothering you?"
dialogues.text: "Is it still bothering you?"

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「……そんなことは、ないけど……」
dialogues.en: "Not really..."
dialogues.text: "Not really..."

dialogues.jp:
全然、まったく、ちっとも吹っ切れていないよ
うだった。
dialogues.en: Obviously it is.
dialogues.text: Obviously it is.

dialogues.jp:
まあ、音夢らしいと言えば、らしい。妙に大人
ぶっているようで、基本的にガキだから……。
dialogues.en:
After all, that's how Nemu is. In a way she acts maturely,
but basically she's still a child inside.
dialogues.text:
After all, that's how Nemu is. In a way she acts maturely,
but basically she's still a child inside.

dialogues.jp:
「……誘ってくれとは言われたけれど、強引に
　拉致してでも連れてこいとは言われなかった」
dialogues.en: "I was asked to invite you, but not drag you there."
dialogues.text: "I was asked to invite you, but not drag you there."

dialogues.jp:
「もし、そういう風に言われたら、さすがに首
　を振っただろうけど」
dialogues.en:
"If I was told to drag you there, I would've said no
anyway."
dialogues.text:
"If I was told to drag you there, I would've said no
anyway."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「えっ？」
dialogues.en: "What?"
dialogues.text: "What?"

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
「……俺は、お前を無理に連れていこうとは思
　わない」
dialogues.en: "I don't want to take you there if you don't want to."
dialogues.text: "I don't want to take you there if you don't want to."

dialogues.jp:
胸を押さえ、しゅんと俯く。それがスイッチで
あるかのように、また胸が疼きだした。
dialogues.en:
Holding her chest, Nemu slowly droops her head. At that
moment, my chest begins to ache.
dialogues.text:
Holding her chest, Nemu slowly droops her head. At that
moment, my chest begins to ache.

dialogues.jp: （いてて……）
dialogues.en: (It hurts...)
dialogues.text: (It hurts...)

dialogues.jp: 「まあ、とにかく、考えておいてくれよな」
dialogues.en: "Why don't you think about it? Let me know."
dialogues.text: "Why don't you think about it? Let me know."

dialogues.jp: そう言って、俺は居間を後にした。
dialogues.en: I left the living room.
dialogues.text: I left the living room.

dialogues.jp: 鏡合わせのように、お互い胸に手をあてていた。
dialogues.en: Both of us are pressing our hand to our chest.
dialogues.text: Both of us are pressing our hand to our chest.

dialogues.jp: ◆招待券を音夢へ◆
dialogues.en: ◆Junichi◆
dialogues.text: ◆Junichi◆

dialogues.jp:
音夢に美春の誕生日の招待券を渡した。まだ、
音夢は吹っ切れてないみたいだった。
dialogues.en: "Hi, niisan."
dialogues.text: "Hi, niisan."

dialogues.jp: 音夢も参加してくれるといいのだが……。
dialogues.en: Nemu turns her eyes from the TV to me with a smile.
dialogues.text: Nemu turns her eyes from the TV to me with a smile.
